turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, good afternoon. Am I speaking with Mr. Singh from Chennai?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Singh. Who is this calling?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: My name is Ananya from Global Connect. I am calling regarding a special upgrade for your home broadband plan.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Broadband? I already have a connection, I do not need a new one.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I understand, sir. This is just an offer to increase your speed to one gigabit for the same monthly price.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: One gigabit? I only use it for the news and calling my children, I don't know what this means.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It simply means your videos will load faster, Mr. Singh. We are offering this to a few select customers in your area.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am not sure. Is there any extra charge for this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No extra monthly charge, sir. We only provide a one-time installation credit of eighty thousand rupees for corporate accounts, but for you, it is completely free.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Eighty thousand? That sounds like a lot of money. I am getting confused now.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please do not worry, sir. There is no payment required from your side at all.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Can you just send the details to my email? I will talk to my son first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Of course, sir. I will send the brochure to your registered email address right away.
